title: Mom Fights Police After Endangering Her Baby
description:
Submit a tip! Tips@Midwest-Safety.com

Please consider JOINING for $1 a month. It *really* helps us do original reporting like this. 

CONTACT US:
Complaints? Video submissions? Sponsorships? Collabs? Business inquires? 
Email our board at Tips@Midwest-Safety.com

BE NICE:
The individuals presented in these videos may be suffering from the effects of alcohol, drug abuse, a mental health disorder or simply having a bad day. The videos should NOT be presumed to be representative of their general behavior. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect. 

RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN:
Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to request removal. 
Email: mn.safety.alerts@gmail.com

This suspect, Monica, was charged with four counts of felony felony battery on a law enforcement officer, felony resisting with violence, resisting without violence, felony child neglect, and felony child abuse. Court records indicate the charges of resisting without violence, child neglect, child abuse, and two of the battery charges were dropped. I used to say to myself with every well-being check call, I hope this is not the one that leaves me in shock. And still, her focus is drifting and wrapped up in herself instead of her kid on the floor. When the officers step in and authorities in her space, she's unable to answer simple questions. Instead of switching into mom mode, she shifts in a fight mode and not because she's protecting her child, it's because she's protecting her warped version of the events. Remember, every second these officers are wrestling with her is a second that child is still vulnerable. And that's what makes these calls so dangerous because it's distraction from the real victim.
